description: The invoices the firm has sent one of the signed-in customer's companies, newest first: number, what it was for, dates, total, what's still owed and status ("paid", "open", "overdue", "uncollectible"), with the outstanding total. by_bank_transfer means the customer pays it by bank transfer, not online. create_billing_link opens an invoice, the statement of accounts or the Billing page to pay.

status.description: "outstanding" for only what's still owed. Defaults to all.

name: list_invoices
title: List a company's invoices
